headline: Expanse Returns to Parity; Nevish Line's Toll Mounts
war_summary: Our last edition recorded Colonial gains across the Weathered Expanse; the ledger has been rewritten since. Three hours of churn have restored a three-three balance there, three stands in ruin, after forty-nine flag movements in a day and nine in the past two hours, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk the busiest grounds. On the Nevish Line the Wardens have clawed back a post — six stands to two — while that front now bears the war's heaviest toll, upward of six hundred casualties an hour on either side and climbing; Blackcoat Way sees the sharpest of it. Linn Mercy, briefly cooling, has flared anew, Warden losses running double the Colonial rate about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, with movement reported within the hour. In Mooring County a first stand has passed to Colonial colours, eleven yet Warden, the Wind Hills still drawing fire. Marban Hollow has been silent since the small hours, its four-three split intact. Callahans Passage raises no flag yet counts nearly twelve thousand casualties in a day, and Stlican Shelf stirs mildly at Briar. It is day 736; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
